name: Obydullah Restaurant Core
author: obydullah

sections.description:
Obydullah Restaurant Core is a purpose-built WordPress plugin that gives restaurant websites everything they need behind the scenes. It registers custom post types, custom taxonomies, meta boxes, and a custom database table so you can manage hero sliders, menus, testimonials, opening hours, reservations, and more, all from the WordPress admin.

It is the official companion plugin for the Obydullah Restaurant theme but works independently with any restaurant theme.

What It Manages

  • Hero Slider — Create and reorder featured banner slides with titles, subtitles, and images.
  • Chef’s Specials — A single spotlight post for showcasing a signature dish with description and image.
  • Menu Items — Individual menu entries with subtitles, prices, and a hierarchical Menu Category taxonomy for grouping (Starters, Mains, Desserts, etc.).
  • Menu Area — A single post for managing the menu section’s introductory text.
  • Testimonials — Customer reviews with quotes, names, and roles.
  • Testimonial Area — A single post for section-level settings.
  • Opening Hours — A repeatable day/time table with a note field, managed through a custom admin interface.
  • Table Reservations — An AJAX-powered booking form backed by a custom wp_obirc_bookings database table, with an admin list table for viewing, sorting, filtering, and bulk-deleting entries.
  • Footer Settings — Centralised footer management: logo text, tagline, social media URLs, quick links (repeatable), contact info, and copyright.
  • About Page — Chef story, philosophy, and a repeatable slider with title, subtitle, and Media Library background images.
  • Contact Page — Address, phone, email, Google Maps embed URL, and Contact Form 7 shortcode with auto-detection.

Why a Custom Plugin

Restaurant websites have very specific content needs. Instead of stuffing everything into theme options or relying on five different plugins, Obydullah Restaurant Core provides a single, focused plugin that handles all restaurant-specific content management. Each section maps to a dedicated WordPress post type, so content is managed through the familiar post editor, not a proprietary panel.

Key Technical Details

  • 10 Custom Post Types — Hero Slider, Chef’s Special, Menu Item, Menu Area, Testimonial, Testimonial Area, Opening Hours, About Page, Contact Page, and Footer.
  • 1 Custom Taxonomy — Menu Category (hierarchical, for grouping menu items).
  • Custom Database Table — wp_obirc_bookings for structured reservation storage with dbDelta() lifecycle management.
  • Admin Dashboard — A central card-based dashboard for quick navigation to every section.
  • Single-Instance Enforcement — Seven post types are automatically limited to one entry. Creating a new post redirects to the existing edit screen.
  • Security — All form submissions and AJAX requests use nonce verification. Database queries use $wpdb->prepare().
  • Input Sanitisation — Consistent use of sanitize_text_field, sanitize_email, sanitize_textarea_field, esc_html, esc_attr, and esc_url.
  • Translation Ready — All user-facing strings use __() and esc_html_e() with the obydullah-restaurant-core text domain.
  • Zero Front-End Dependencies — The plugin handles admin-side content management only. All front-end rendering is handled by the theme.

Built With

  • Native WordPress Custom Post Types and Taxonomies
  • Custom Meta Boxes with per-section save handlers
  • WP_List_Table for the reservations admin table
  • jQuery for repeater field add/remove/reindex
  • WordPress Media Library integration for image selection
  • $wpdb->prepare() and dbDelta() for database operations

sections.installation:
From WordPress.org

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin.
  2. Search for Obydullah Restaurant Core.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Navigate to the Restaurant Core menu in your admin sidebar to access the dashboard.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin from WordPress.org or GitHub.
  2. Upload the obydullah-restaurant-core folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate through Plugins in the WordPress admin.
  4. Navigate to the Restaurant Core menu in your admin sidebar.

After Activation

  • A new top-level menu called Restaurant Core appears in the admin sidebar with a dashboard linking to every section.
  • Custom post type menu items (Hero Slider, Menu Items, Testimonials, etc.) are also available directly.
  • The reservations table is created automatically on activation and removed on uninstall.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin required for the Obydullah Restaurant theme?

Yes, it is recommended for full functionality. The theme reads data from the custom post types this plugin registers. Without it, sections like the hero slider, menu, testimonials, and reservation form will have no content to display.

Does it work with other themes?

Yes. The plugin registers standard custom post types and taxonomies that any theme can query. You may need to adjust your theme templates to match the post type slugs and meta field keys used by this plugin.

Does it include a reservation system?

Yes. It includes an AJAX-powered reservation form with nonce verification and server-side validation. Bookings are stored in a custom database table (wp_obirc_bookings) and managed through an admin list table with sorting, filtering, and bulk delete. The front-end form itself is rendered by the theme.

What fields does the reservation form collect?

Name, email, phone number, party size, date, time, and optional notes.

Can I create multiple hero slides?

Yes. The Hero Slider post type supports multiple entries. Each slide has a title, subtitle, and featured image. Ordering is controlled via page attributes.

Which post types are limited to a single entry?

Chef’s Special, Menu Area, Testimonial Area, Opening Hours, Footer, About Page, and Contact Page. If you try to create a new post when one already exists, you will be redirected to edit the existing one.

Does it include front-end styles or scripts?

No. The plugin is purely a content management layer. All front-end rendering is handled by the theme.

How do I report bugs or contribute?

Visit the GitHub repository to open issues or submit pull requests.
